capture.surface: Deployed NPA Agent UI, View tab, fullscreen embedded Rerun viewer
capture.method: Playwright browser screen recording of the actual viewer
capture.input_method: Drop the local RRD into the embedded viewer
capture.interaction: Step through dataset_row 0 through 7; hold row 2 for eight seconds
capture.processing: Trim setup footage; transcode VP8 browser capture to H.264 MP4; no recreated frames

limitations: The UI capture is real; its RRD contains the existing synthetic numeric LeRobot fixture and programmatic labels. This is not real robot footage, FiftyOne labeling interaction, native dataset export, training, or cloud workflow execution. Playback timing is for human review, not robot capture time.
